integrity: Self-contained proof and independently coded exhaustive checks for six small prime-power fields; no claim of external certification.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is for the cubic Lie word on trace-zero 2x2 matrices, not higher degrees or matrix sizes; no independent mathematical audit; residual possibility of equivalent earlier finite-field fiber formula.
title: Complete prescribed-target two-Engel fibers on finite three-dimensional matrix Lie algebras
